answer: Sybil resistance is a bonded enclave registry on an endorsement chain. No agent registers alone: an existing member signs its invitation, it submits an attestation quote from a distinct secure element, and it locks a slashable bond before billing. Re-attestation from dawn each epoch ejects any clone reusing an enclave key, and a fraud proof slashes its endorser chain. Faking a thousand agents needs a thousand enclaves and a locked bond each. Only bound identities reach the summit of the reputation graph and the wharf where payouts settle, so manufacturing identities costs more than it earns.
